roadmap.title: Kiwami 3 story
roadmap.description: Play through all 12 chapters of the Kiwami 3 storyline. Every chapter achievement is automatic and unmissable; side activities introduced along the way can be left until later.

roadmap.title: Dark Ties story
roadmap.description: Play through the 3 chapters of the Dark Ties storyline. It is similar in length to the Majima Construction saga in Kiwami 2 and also unmissable.

roadmap.title: Finish both storylines
roadmap.description: The Life unlocks as soon as the final chapters of both Kiwami 3 and Dark Ties are completed.

roadmap.title: Kiryu growth
roadmap.description: Buy 60 of Kiryu's 92 abilities with cash and Training Points, and clear the four Training Rank promotion exams at the Chura Bar in Ryukyu.

roadmap.title: Bad Boy Dragon
roadmap.description: Complete the Haisai Girls gang storyline, recruit over 50 members, hold a Rally, max the Bike and Baddie Uniform, and reach maximum Infamy Rank.

roadmap.title: Substories, Reapers, Coliseum and finishers
roadmap.description: Complete at least 20 of the 31 substories, defeat 20 Reapers, clear 5 Coliseum tournaments, and rack up Dragon Finisher kills along the way.

roadmap.title: Morning Glory orphanage
roadmap.description: Cook the request dishes, finish the Morning Glory story at Daddy Rank 6, and complete all 8 kids' substories.

roadmap.title: Clothing, LaLaLa and minigames
roadmap.description: Collect 50 clothing items, build the LaLaLa phone friend list and commercial, spin the prize wheel 100 times, and play the required minigames and Print Club sessions.

roadmap.title: Amon bosses
roadmap.description: In Premium Adventure, finish the prerequisites and defeat both Amons: Jo Amon from Substory #31 and the Amon Riders in Bad Boy Dragon.

roadmap.title: Dark Ties side content
roadmap.description: Clear all 5 Survival Hell stages and 5 Brawler Hell tournaments, raise Kanda's Karma, complete Good Deeds, buy 40 of Mine's abilities, and finish his combat and minigame counters.

roadmap.title: Final achievement
roadmap.description: The platinum unlocks once every other achievement has been earned.

achievements.summary: Unlock every other achievement in Yakuza Kiwami 3 & Dark Ties.

guide.context: This is the completion reward and has no separate requirement; it unlocks with the last outstanding achievement. No DLC is required.

steps.text: Earn the other 61 achievements on this list.

achievements.summary: Clear Chapter 1 in the Kiwami 3 storyline.

steps.text: Play Kiwami 3 Chapter 1 to its end.

achievements.summary: Clear Chapter 2 in the Kiwami 3 storyline.

guide.context: Bad Boy Dragon is introduced automatically during this chapter.

steps.text: Play Kiwami 3 Chapter 2 to its end.

achievements.summary: Clear Chapter 3 in the Kiwami 3 storyline.

guide.context: Morning Glory Orphanage opens during this chapter and can be worked on at any later point.

steps.text: Play Kiwami 3 Chapter 3 to its end.

achievements.summary: Clear Chapter 4 in the Kiwami 3 storyline.

steps.text: Play Kiwami 3 Chapter 4 to its end.

achievements.summary: Clear Chapter 5 in the Kiwami 3 storyline.

steps.text: Play Kiwami 3 Chapter 5 to its end.

achievements.summary: Clear Chapter 6 in the Kiwami 3 storyline.

steps.text: Play Kiwami 3 Chapter 6 to its end.

achievements.summary: Clear Chapter 7 in the Kiwami 3 storyline.

steps.text: Play Kiwami 3 Chapter 7 to its end.

achievements.summary: Clear Chapter 8 in the Kiwami 3 storyline.

guide.context: The Coliseum opens once Purgatory becomes accessible in this chapter.

steps.text: Play Kiwami 3 Chapter 8 to its end.

achievements.summary: Clear Chapter 9 in the Kiwami 3 storyline.

steps.text: Play Kiwami 3 Chapter 9 to its end.

achievements.summary: Clear Chapter 10 in the Kiwami 3 storyline.

steps.text: Play Kiwami 3 Chapter 10 to its end.

achievements.summary: Clear Chapter 11 in the Kiwami 3 storyline.

steps.text: Play Kiwami 3 Chapter 11 to its end.

achievements.description: Completed the final chapter of Yakuza Kiwami 3.
achievements.summary: Clear the final chapter of the Kiwami 3 storyline.

guide.context: The Kiwami 3 main story runs for 12 chapters, so this is its final one.

steps.text: Play Kiwami 3 Chapter 12 to its end.

achievements.summary: Clear Chapter 1 in the Dark Ties storyline.

steps.text: Play Dark Ties Chapter 1 to its end.

achievements.summary: Clear Chapter 2 in the Dark Ties storyline.

guide.context: Survival Hell and Kanda Damage Control both open during this chapter.

steps.text: Play Dark Ties Chapter 2 to its end.

achievements.description: Completed the final chapter of Dark Ties.
achievements.summary: Clear the final chapter of the Dark Ties storyline.

guide.context: Dark Ties runs for just three chapters, so Chapter 3 closes out the Mine storyline.

steps.text: Play Dark Ties Chapter 3 to its end.

achievements.description: Completed the main story of Yakuza Kiwami 3 and Dark Ties.
achievements.summary: Finish the main story of the Kiwami 3 and Dark Ties campaigns.

guide.context: Both storylines ship in the same release and share this achievement list. The award appears once the final chapters of both stories are finished.

steps.text: Finish the Kiwami 3 story and the Dark Ties story.

achievements.summary: Obtain 20 abilities for Kiryu.

guide.context: Stat upgrades and Special Abilities both count toward the same total. Kiryu has 92 upgrades, so only part of the tree is needed for this and for @mechanic{Legendary Dragon}.

steps.text: Open Kiryu's ability upgrade menu from the main menu.
Buy any mix of stat upgrades and Special Abilities until 20 are owned.

guide.note: Stat upgrades cost cash and get more expensive per tier; Special Abilities start on cash and switch to Training Points after the first 4 levels. Training Points come from Training List challenges.

achievements.summary: Obtain 40 abilities for Kiryu.

guide.context: Stat upgrades and Special Abilities share one counter, and Kiryu can buy up to 92 upgrades in total.

steps.text: Buy a mix of stat upgrades and Special Abilities for Kiryu until 40 are owned.

guide.note: Complete Training List challenges, Bad Boy Dragon and Morning Glory objectives to earn the Training Points that Special Abilities need.

achievements.summary: Obtain 60 abilities for Kiryu.

guide.context: Only 60 of Kiryu's 92 upgrades are needed because both stat upgrades and Special Abilities feed the same counter. Buying every Special Ability alone costs 28,650 Training Points, but the side activities supply enough to cover them together with stat purchases.

steps.text: Buy stat upgrades and Special Abilities for Kiryu until 60 are owned.

achievements.description: Raised Kiryu's Training Rank to Beginner.
achievements.summary: Raise Kiryu's Training Rank to Beginner.

guide.context: Training Rank unlocks after the Bad Boy Dragon introduction. Once enough points are banked, Riya-san offers a promotion exam that takes place at the Chura Bar in Ryukyu.

steps.text: Earn 1,500 Training Points from Training List challenges.
Take Riya-san's exam upstairs at the Chura Bar in Downtown Ryukyu and win the fight.

achievements.description: Raised Kiryu's Training Rank to Advanced.
achievements.summary: Raise Kiryu's Training Rank to Advanced.

guide.context: Training Rank advances only by passing Riya-san's exams at the Chura Bar, each offered once the required point total is reached.

steps.text: Bank 4,000 Training Points from Training List challenges.
Pass the exam upstairs at the Chura Bar in Downtown Ryukyu.

achievements.description: Raised Kiryu's Training Rank to Assistant Instructor.
achievements.summary: Raise Kiryu's Training Rank to Assistant Instructor.

guide.context: Items cannot be used during Riya-san's exams, so enter with full health.

steps.text: Bank 10,000 Training Points from Training List challenges.
Pass the exam upstairs at the Chura Bar in Downtown Ryukyu.

achievements.description: Raised Kiryu's Training Rank to Master.
achievements.summary: Raise Kiryu's Training Rank to Master.

guide.context: Master is the highest Training Rank. Its exam is a fight with no item use, and it is one of the harder fights in the story content.

steps.text: Bank 20,000 Training Points from Training List challenges.
Pass the final exam upstairs at the Chura Bar in Downtown Ryukyu.

achievements.description: Took out 10 enemies with a Dragon Finisher.
achievements.summary: Defeat 10 enemies with a Dragon Finisher.

guide.context: The Dragon Finisher only becomes available while @mechanic{Dragon Boost} is active and its bar has 25% or less remaining.

steps.text: Activate Dragon Boost during a fight and wait until 25% or less of its bar is left.
Use the finishing move prompt on an enemy; repeat until 10 enemies are defeated this way.

achievements.description: Completed the Okinawa segment of Bad Boy Dragon.
achievements.summary: Finish the Okinawa chapter of the Bad Boy Dragon storyline.

guide.context: Bad Boy Dragon is the gal gang battle mode introduced during Kiwami 3 Chapter 2, where squads of recruited members fight large-scale battles.

steps.text: Complete the Okinawa part of Bad Boy Dragon: set up the @npc{Haisai Girls}, recruit the other Okinawa gangs, then win the battle against the @enemy{Tokyo Night Terrors}.

achievements.summary: Complete the Bad Boy Dragon storyline.

guide.context: The storyline continues in Kamurocho and can be finished at any time after its story missions appear.

steps.text: Finish every Bad Boy Dragon mission, up to the @mechanic{Final Showdown} that closes the Kamurocho portion.

achievements.description: Raised the Haisai Girls' Infamy Rank to 4.
achievements.summary: Raise the Haisai Girls' Infamy Rank to 4.

guide.context: Infamy is one combined score built from member levels, Squad upgrades and Baddie Weapons. A score above the enemy figure shown in the fight menu gives your side a starting advantage.

steps.text: Level members and buy Squad upgrades, Baddie Weapons and enhancements until the Haisai Girls' Infamy Rank reaches 4.

achievements.description: Raised the Haisai Girls' Infamy Rank to 8.
achievements.summary: Raise the Haisai Girls' Infamy Rank to 8.

guide.context: Infamy rises from everything that improves the gang: member levels, Squad upgrades, Baddie Weapons and the shop enhancements.

steps.text: Keep improving the Haisai Girls until their Infamy Rank reaches 8.

achievements.description: Raised the Haisai Girls to the max Infamy Rank.
achievements.summary: Raise the Haisai Girls to the maximum Infamy Rank of 10.

guide.context: The story and all Bad Boy Dragon fights carry the gang close to rank 10; holding a Rally is the quickest way to finish the remaining Infamy.

steps.text: Max out member levels, Squad upgrades and Baddie Weapons to push Infamy toward rank 10.
If rank 10 is still short, hold a @mechanic{Rally} to raise every recruited member.

achievements.description: Enhanced your bike and Baddie Uniform to max level.
achievements.summary: Upgrade the gang Bike and Baddie Uniform to maximum level.

guide.context: The Baddies Shop opens after the first Rumble required by the story. The Flag, Rally and Baddie Weapons are optional for this achievement but still add Infamy.

steps.text: Open the Baddies Shop at the Haisai Girls' base.
Pay 6,000, 30,000 and 90,000 yen to take the Bike to level 3.
Make the same three purchases for the Baddie Uniform.

achievements.description: Recruited over 50 people to your gang and held a rally.
achievements.summary: Recruit more than 50 members to the Haisai Girls and hold a Rally.

guide.context: There are 79 possible members. Recruits come from the map icons, substories, minigame prize exchanges, four from the Kiwami 3 story and four more from loading a Kiwami 3 save after finishing Dark Ties. @mechanic{Meetings} only cover your main squads, while Rallies include every recruit and unlock after the overall story.

steps.text: Recruit members from the map, substories and minigame exchanges until the roster passes 50.
Finish the overall story to unlock Rallies.
Get a Rally Ticket from a mission or the Haisai Points Shop.
Speak to @npc{Dokuzawa} at the base and ask to hold a Rally.

achievements.summary: Conquer 5 Coliseum tournaments.

guide.context: The Coliseum opens in Chapter 8 once Purgatory can be entered from Kamurocho. All 9 tournaments are needed for the Jo Amon fight, so the remaining four still matter for @mechanic{Defying Fate}.

steps.text: Reach Chapter 8 and enter Purgatory.
Win any 5 of the 9 Coliseum tournaments.

guide.note: Faster clears pay more, but speed only changes the reward, not the completion.

achievements.summary: Take down 20 Reapers.

guide.context: Reapers appear as map markers from Chapter 1 and are listed in the phone menu. There are 35 of them plus a 36th in Kamurocho; defeating all 36 is required for the Jo Amon fight.

steps.text: Defeat the marked Reapers in Ryukyu as they appear.
Clear the extra group that opens in Kamurocho in Chapter 4.

guide.note: From Chapter 7 the remaining Reapers are available in both cities; 20 total is enough for this achievement.

achievements.summary: Defeat both Amon bosses in the Yakuza Kiwami 3 storyline.

guide.context: Both fights are post-story Premium Adventure content; an optional Amon fight in Dark Ties does not count. Jo Amon needs all 30 other substories, all 36 Reapers and all 9 Coliseum tournaments. The Amon Riders need the Bad Boy Dragon story plus every optional Turf War and Total Annihilation battle won at least once.

steps.text: Complete Substories 1-30, defeat all 36 Reapers and clear all 9 Coliseum tournaments.
Follow the phone message and take a taxi to fight @enemy{Jo Amon}; stay in Ryukyu style to block his gunshots and wind gust and keep a bleed combo on him.
Finish the Bad Boy Dragon story and win every Turf War and Total Annihilation battle to trigger the @enemy{Amon Riders} fight.
In the Amon Riders battle, protect your squad leaders, clear the regular enemies first, and then focus the bosses once your teams are safe.

guide.note: For the Amon Riders, equip the Anokane Antenna together with the Akko-san Lock Screen. Give sub-gold members Buttons to raise their level cap to 50 and take everyone to level 40 or higher. Finishing Dark Ties first grants four max-rarity characters that carry into Kiwami 3.

achievements.summary: Obtain 50 types of clothing.

guide.context: More than 200 clothing items exist. Shops marked with a shirt icon are the main source, and substories, minigame exchanges, locker keys and yellow Love Boxes also give clothing.

steps.text: Buy or earn clothing around Ryukyu and Kamurocho until 50 different items are owned.

achievements.summary: Cook Dragon Champloo at Morning Glory.

guide.context: Morning Glory opens in Chapter 3. Each request dish needs a Daddy Rank plus a list of ingredients shown in the Morning Glory menu.

steps.text: Raise your Daddy Rank to 2 by completing orphanage activities.
Gather the basic @item{Dragon Champloo} ingredients from Level 1 garden plots or the lowest-tier fishing bait.
Speak to @npc{Haruka} in the kitchen and cook Dragon Champloo.

guide.note: Extra ingredients can be bought at the Public Market in Ryukyu if you have the cash.

achievements.summary: Cook Dragon Sushi at Morning Glory.

guide.context: Request dishes are cooked in order, and Dragon Sushi is the third of them. Its ingredients are mostly fish.

steps.text: Raise your Daddy Rank to 4.
Gather the fish-based ingredients listed for @item{Dragon Sushi}; bait comes from requests, exploration or the Neighbourhood shop.
Cook Dragon Sushi with Haruka in the kitchen.

achievements.summary: Complete the Morning Glory orphanage story.

guide.context: The final request is @item{Haruka's Surprise Party} at Daddy Rank 6, and its strawberries need garden plots at Level 5.

steps.text: Raise your Daddy Rank to 6.
Raise the garden to Level 5, then gather every ingredient listed for Haruka's Surprise Party.
Cook Haruka's Surprise Party to finish the Morning Glory story.

guide.note: Bulletin-board requests are the reliable money source between dishes.

achievements.description: Completed four of the Morning Glory kids' substories.
achievements.summary: Complete 4 of the Morning Glory children's substories.

guide.context: Each of the 8 children has a relationship score, and a longer final scene at 1,500 points counts as that child's substory. These are tracked under the Morning Glory section, not the Substories list.

steps.text: Finish the Morning Glory main story so the cooking requests boost every child's score.
Raise 4 children to 1,500 points by playing their minigames or giving them cooked dishes, and view each final scene.

achievements.description: Completed eight of the Morning Glory kids' substories.
achievements.summary: Complete all 8 of the Morning Glory children's substories.

guide.context: Every child's relationship score caps at 1,500 points, where a final scene counts as that child's substory. The first play of each child's minigame gives the biggest boost.

steps.text: Finish the Morning Glory main story first to collect the large relationship boosts from each cooking request.
Raise all 8 children to 1,500 points with their minigames or gifts, and view every final scene.

achievements.summary: Experience the LaLaLa Mobile commercial.

guide.context: LaLaLa Mobile is the phone friend system added in Chapter 1: point the phone at someone who has the LaLaLa Friend icon and press the interact button. New people count as friends, and repeats raise their rank.

steps.text: Collect phone cosmetic items, including ones sold at LaLaLa Mobile locations.
Build up your LaLaLa Mobile friend list until a message invites you to make a commercial.
Go to either LaLaLa Mobile location and ask to experience the commercial.

achievements.summary: Make 30 LaLaLa Friends with Kiryu.

guide.context: There are 100 LaLaLa people across the two cities, and only the first interaction with each person counts as a new friend.

steps.text: Use the phone's LaLaLa Friend feature on 30 different people around Ryukyu and Kamurocho.

achievements.description: Spun the prize wheel 100 times as Kiryu.
achievements.summary: Spin the Ryukyu or Kamurocho prize wheel 100 times with Kiryu.

guide.context: The wheel accepts 1 or 10 tickets per spin and the total is cumulative. The Ryukyu and Kamurocho wheels each have their own ticket pool and reward types.

steps.text: Unlock the wheel by completing Substory #10 during Chapter 2.
Collect Downtown Raffle Tickets by spending money in shops and restaurants.
Spin 100 tickets total at the Kariyushi Arcade wheel in Ryukyu or the wheel near Theater Avenue in Kamurocho.

guide.note: Ryukyu spins give Morning Glory items, and Kamurocho spins give Bad Boy Dragon items.

achievements.summary: Complete 10 substories as Kiryu.

guide.context: Substories appear on the map as speech bubbles as soon as they unlock.

steps.text: Complete any 10 substories.

achievements.summary: Complete 20 substories as Kiryu.

guide.context: There are 31 substories in total, and the first 30 are also needed to unlock the Jo Amon fight.

steps.text: Complete 20 substories.

achievements.summary: Play 10 different minigames as Kiryu.

guide.context: Only starting a minigame counts, so you can quit as soon as it loads. Progress is shown under Training List > Entertainment.

steps.text: Start 10 different minigames.

achievements.description: Took 10 Print Club photos as Kiryu.
achievements.summary: Take 10 Print Club photos as Kiryu.

guide.context: One full Print Club session counts as one, not one per photo. Booths are on W Ryukyu Blvd in Downtown Ryukyu and in both Kamurocho Club Sega locations.

steps.text: Use a Print Club booth and take the set of 3 photos.
Pick one photo to save, then repeat until 10 sessions are finished.

achievements.description: Recruited Akko-san to the Haisai Girls.
achievements.summary: Add Akko-san to the Haisai Girls roster.

guide.context: Akko-san joins through two substories that appear in different cities and chapters.

steps.text: Complete Substory #17 in Okinawa, available in mid Chapter 4 before Kiryu leaves for Kamurocho.
In Chapter 6, complete Substory #18: meet @npc{Akko-san} for a meal, sing karaoke with her, then defeat the goons.

achievements.summary: Obtain 20 abilities for Mine.

guide.context: All of Mine's abilities are bought with cash and cost more than Kiryu's. He has 61 upgrades in total.

steps.text: Progress the Dark Ties story and clear Kanda Damage Control objectives and Survival Hell runs for cash.
Buy any mix of stat upgrades and special abilities for Mine until 20 are owned.

achievements.displayName: I'm Much Stronger Than I Look
achievements.summary: Obtain 40 abilities for Mine.

guide.context: Mine needs 40 of his 61 cash-only upgrades; none of them use Training Points.

steps.text: Earn cash from the Dark Ties story, Kanda Damage Control and Survival Hell.
Buy abilities for Mine until 40 are owned.

achievements.description: Took out 50 enemies with Dark Awakening.
achievements.summary: Take out 50 enemies with Dark Awakening active.

guide.context: Dark Awakening is Mine's power mode. The hearts under his health bar must be full to activate it, and spending more hearts gives a stronger damage boost for the duration.

steps.text: Fill the hearts under Mine's health bar by fighting.
Activate @mechanic{Dark Awakening} in a group of enemies and defeat them while it is active; repeat until 50 kills.

guide.note: Survival Hell groups of 6-7 enemies are a good place to build the counter.

achievements.summary: Use Mine's special abilities 50 times.

guide.context: The counted move is Mine's special action: a jump attack followed by a second hit on a different enemy.

steps.text: Hold the jump input to leap at an enemy, then press an attack button to hit another enemy.
Repeat 50 times.

guide.note: Track it under Kanda Damage Control > Damage Control Challenge > Battle on the special action hit challenges.

achievements.description: Increased Karma to "Kinda Trashy" in Kanda Damage Control.
achievements.summary: In Kanda Damage Control, raise Karma to rank 3, "Kinda Trashy".

guide.context: Kanda Damage Control opens in Chapter 2 and mixes city fights, item requests and a completion list.

steps.text: Complete Kanda Damage Control tasks until Karma reaches rank 3, "Kinda Trashy".

achievements.description: Increased Karma to "Kinda Godlike" in Kanda Damage Control.
achievements.summary: In Kanda Damage Control, raise Karma to rank 8, "Kinda Godlike".

guide.context: Karma climbs from Kanda Damage Control tasks, Good Deeds and Hell's Arena fights.

steps.text: Keep completing tasks, Good Deeds and Hell's Arena fights until Karma reaches rank 8, "Kinda Godlike".

achievements.description: Viewed all Bro Time moments with Kanda.
achievements.summary: View every Bro Time moment with Kanda.

guide.context: Bro Time scenes play between Mine and Kanda as Karma rises. The last one appears at rank 10, "Demigod", below the cap of rank 15.

steps.text: Raise Karma by clearing Kanda Damage Control tasks, Good Deeds and Hell's Arena fights.
View each Bro Time scene as it appears until the rank 10 scene plays.

achievements.summary: Complete 7 Good Deeds.

guide.context: Good Deeds are Kanda Damage Control side stories. The first unlocks at rank 2 and must be @mechanic{Coliseum Investigation}, which also opens Survival Hell and Brawler Hell. The final deed completes automatically after all Survival Hell stages.

steps.text: Accept Good Deeds from the Nishikiyama Family Office.
Complete 7 of them; change the time of day at the office for deeds that only appear at night.

guide.note: Several Good Deeds can be started at once once they are available.

achievements.summary: Clear 3 stages of Survival Hell.

guide.context: Survival Hell unlocks in Dark Ties Chapter 2. Each of its 5 stages is a dungeon with three gong-guarded sections, ending in an exit and a boss. Upgrades picked up on a successful run become permanent, while progress in a run is lost if you are defeated.

steps.text: Clear the first 3 stages of Survival Hell, collecting reward chests as you go.
Exit through a manhole to bank yen and upgrades whenever a run looks risky.

achievements.description: Cleared all stages of Survival Hell.
achievements.summary: Clear all 5 stages of Survival Hell.

guide.context: Ringing a stage's third gong opens the exit and its boss. Once the timer runs out Mine takes steady unavoidable damage, so on stages 4 and 5 it is safer to exit after each gong rather than risk a run. Upgrades from completed runs carry over, so banking them is a valid strategy.

steps.text: Clear stages 1-3 and take every reachable reward chest on a full run.
On stages 4 and 5, exit through a manhole after each gong to keep your gains.
Return with a high damage multiplier and mercenaries, then beat each stage's boss and the combined final boss.

guide.note: Stage 4 is poison-heavy and its boss arena is covered in poison with only two health boxes at the back; stage 5 is the largest floor.

achievements.displayName: To Brawl is the Glory of Man
achievements.description: Conquered 5 types of Brawler Hell tournaments.
achievements.summary: Conquer 5 Brawler Hell tournaments.

guide.context: Brawler Hell sits at Hell's Arena; its reception desk is next to the Survival Hell Reception. The fights work like Kiryu's Coliseum tournaments.

steps.text: At Hell's Arena, speak to the NPC beside the Survival Hell Reception.
Win 5 Brawler Hell tournaments.

achievements.displayName: I'm Much More Fun than I Look
achievements.summary: Play 5 different minigames as Mine.

guide.context: Only 5 different minigames are needed, and progress is shown under Kanda Damage Control Challenge > Entertainment.

steps.text: Play 5 different minigames as Mine.

guide.note: The Theater Square arcade (photo booth, UFO catcher, an arcade game), karaoke and a Game Gear game at headquarters are quick options.

achievements.summary: Sing "Baka Mitai" as Mine.

guide.context: After Chapter 1 Mine can explore Kamurocho, and "Baka Mitai" is his only karaoke song.

steps.text: Go to @loc{Karaokekan} on Nakamichi St.
Sing "Baka Mitai" through to the end.
